symptom: After the finite-mtime schema regression test compiled, GitHub Actions verify failed one synthetic assertion. The runtime rejected Infinity in the generic evidence-graph preflight with 'non-finite number forbidden in evidence graph', while the test required only the later source.modifiedTimeMs-specific diagnostic. The research method did not fail; post-job cleanup completed.
lesson: A fail-closed validator can reject an invalid value in an earlier whole-graph guard, so a regression assertion requiring only a later field-specific error falsely fails. Separate admission outcome from the diagnostic stage that first rejects it.
guardrail: Assert that the overflow evidence is rejected, and accept either the generic nonfinite evidence-graph diagnostic or the source.modifiedTimeMs-specific finite-number diagnostic. Keep valid finite controls, check complete job logs and post-job cleanup, and do not treat a test assertion failure as a research or platform failure.
